classes.class_summary: DevicesMFE is a UI page class that extends SmartFlow and provides verification and action flows for the HP Smart Devices MFE (Micro Frontend). It handles device management operations, popup interactions, navigation verification, and user interface element interactions for the devices section of the HP Smart application.
